steps.zh: 装进你的 Python 环境

steps.en: Define a problem (or borrow a benchmark) and pick an algorithm
steps.zh: 定义问题（或借一个基准问题），挑一个算法

steps.en: Run the search with a termination budget and a seed
steps.zh: 设定终止条件与随机种子，开跑

steps.en: Evolves the population generation by generation toward the trade-off front
steps.zh: 一代一代演化种群，朝权衡前沿推进

steps.en: Read the Pareto front off res.F and plot it
steps.zh: 从 res.F 读出 Pareto 前沿并画图

value.en: A whole trade-off front from one minimize() call, without writing any evolutionary machinery yourself
value.zh: 一次 minimize() 调用就得到整条权衡前沿，不用自己写任何演化机制

sources: README.rst main @ 2026-09-28 (Usage section, verbatim): pip install -U pymoo; problem = get_problem("zdt1"); algorithm = NSGA2(pop_size=100); res = minimize(problem, algorithm, ('n_gen', 200), seed=1, verbose=True); plot.add(res.F, color="red")
